selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the bad group do when they came into the world and became old enough to choose?
questions.answer: They turned away from faith and did not respond in the right way.

questions.question: What wrong answer did they give to blessings?
questions.answer: They answered with thanklessness.

questions.question: According to the passage, what was wrong with how the wicked treated creatures?
questions.answer: They looked down on them and insulted them.

questions.question: What did they deserve because of this big wrong?
questions.answer: Endless punishment.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the purpose of life’s “capital” and human powers?
questions.answer: They were given for special duties.

questions.question: Why is that idea too small?
questions.answer: Because our abilities were made for higher goals.

questions.question: How many main purposes are named for the senses and abilities in us?
questions.answer: Two.

questions.question: What is the first big purpose for our being created this way?
questions.answer: To recognize Allah’s gifts and give thanks.

questions.question: What is the second main aim?
questions.answer: To know the displays of Allah’s names through our faculties.

questions.question: Which group is talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The sinners and wicked people.

questions.question: What did they choose when they became responsible for their choices?
questions.answer: They chose unbelief.

questions.question: What feeling did they fail to show for the gifts they received?
questions.answer: Gratitude.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way they looked at creatures?
questions.answer: They treated them like they were worthless.

questions.question: What lesson is given about our life and abilities?
questions.answer: They were given for duties, not wasted living.

questions.question: What does the speaker ask the careless self not to think about life?
questions.answer: Not to think life is just for an easy, pleasure-filled worldly living.

questions.question: What kinds of things inside us are mentioned as not being made just for low desires?
questions.answer: Our senses, feelings, body parts, and inner abilities.

questions.question: What should come after noticing Allah’s favors?
questions.answer: Thankfulness and worship.

questions.question: In simple words, what is the second purpose?
questions.answer: To notice Allah’s names through experience and believe in Him.

questions.question: In the passage, what wrong answer did the wicked give to the signs of Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: They answered with unbelief.

questions.question: What happens when people answer blessings with ingratitude?
questions.answer: They misuse what was given and fail in their duty.

questions.question: Why was their wrong so serious?
questions.answer: Because they denied many signs that point to Allah and rejected His names.

questions.question: Why are they said to deserve never-ending punishment?
questions.answer: Because they committed a very great wrong by rejecting all that.

questions.question: What false idea about life is challenged in the passage?
questions.answer: That life is only for pleasure and feeding the body.

questions.question: Are our senses and body parts made only for low wants?
questions.answer: No. They have higher purposes.

title: Warning to the Wicked and the Self Misuse of Human Faculties and Their Two Main Purposes
